verdict.rationale: Gmail API docs describe server push notifications that let an app watch mailboxes for changes, with the API notifying your backend server whenever a mailbox changes. That is a first-party event-subscription mechanism. The evidence only states the capability briefly and gives no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documented event types and payload contents, setup and delivery mechanism details (registration, renewal, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration that push subscriptions work in practice.
